name: @decaf-ts/for-testing
description: Backend and UI testing toolkit for decaf-ts packages: evidence reporting, jest helpers, performance runner and Xray/AgileTest teardowns

scripts.update-dependencies: PREFIX="decaf-ts"; npm ls | grep "$PREFIX" | awk -F/ '{print $NF}' | sed 's/@.*//' | xargs -I package npm update @"$PREFIX"/package
scripts.reset: rm -rf * && git checkout . && git pull && npm run do-install
scripts.test:dist: TEST_TARGET=lib npm run test:all && TEST_TARGET=dist npm run test:all
scripts.prepare-pr: npm run lint-fix && npm run build:prod && npm run coverage && npm run docs
scripts.prepare-release: npm run lint-fix && npm run build:prod && npm run coverage && npm run test:dist && npm run docs
scripts.repo:init:
codex exec "$(cat ./.codex/prompts/repo-setup.md)
base_path is `./`, initialize the repository" -s workspace-write
scripts.repo:tests:
codex exec "$(cat ./.codex/prompts/bulk-tests.md)
base_path is ./ and coverage is 95%" -s workspace-write
scripts.repo:pr: npm run repo:doc && npm run repo:tests && npm run repo:readme
scripts.drawings: for FILE in workdocs/drawings/*.drawio; do echo "converting $FILE to image..." && docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/data rlespinasse/drawio-export --format png $FILE; done && cp -rf workdocs/drawings/export/* workdocs/resources/
scripts.uml: cd workdocs/uml && for FILE in ./*.puml; do docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/work -w /work miy4/plantuml -DPLANTUML_LIMIT_SIZE=8192 -tpng $FILE; done && cd ../.. && cp -fr workdocs/uml/*.png workdocs/resources/
scripts.publish-docs: docker run -it --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$(pwd)/workdocs/confluence:/content" -e ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN="$(DECAF_BANNER=false decaf utils credentials get --name confluence --logLevel error)" ghcr.io/markdown-confluence/publish:latest
scripts.docker:login: docker login ghcr.io -u "$(DECAF_BANNER=false decaf utils credentials get --name docker-user --legacy-file .dockeruser --logLevel error)" -p "$(DECAF_BANNER=false decaf utils credentials get --name docker --legacy-file .dockertoken --logLevel error)"
scripts.docker:build-base: NPM_TOKEN="$(DECAF_BANNER=false decaf utils credentials get --name npm --logLevel error)" DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build --secret id=TOKEN,env=NPM_TOKEN -t ghcr.io/decaf-ts/for-testing:base-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') -t ghcr.io/decaf-ts/for-testing:base-${VERSION:-latest} -f ./Dockerfile .
scripts.docker:publish-base: docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/for-testing:base-$(cat package.json | jq -r '.version') && docker push ghcr.io/decaf-ts/for-testing:base-${VERSION:-latest}

author: Tiago Venceslau
